{{short description|Russian mathematician}}
{{Expand German|topic=bio|date=March 2025}}
'''Dmitrii Andreevich Gudkov''' ({{Langx|ru|Дмитрий Андреевич Гудков}}, also spelled '''Dmitry''';1918–1992) was a Soviet mathematician famous for his work on [[Hilbert's sixteenth problem]] and the related [[Gudkov's conjecture]] in [[algebraic geometry]].<ref>V. Kharlamov – Topology of Real Algebraic Varieties and Related Topics, pp. 1–10</ref> He was a student of [[Aleksandr Andronov]].<ref>[[Vladimir Arnold|Vladimir I. Arnold]] – ''Real Algebraic Geometry'', p. 44</ref><ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=86688}}</ref><ref>Jeremy Gray – ''The Hilbert Challenge'', p. 147</ref>

==Selected papers==
*D. A. Gudkov, "The topology of real projective algebraic varieties", ''Russian Mathematical Surveys'', 1974, 29 (4), pp.&nbsp;1–79 (translated from the Russian original).
*D. A. Gudkov "Periodicity of the Euler characteristic of real algebraic (M—1)-manifolds", ''Functional Analysis and Its Applications'', April–June, 1973, Volume 7, Issue 2, pp.&nbsp;98–102 (translated from the Russian original).
*D.A Gudkov. "Ovals of sixth order curves". in the book ''Nine Papers on Hilbert's 16th Problem'' ''[[American Mathematical Society]]'' 112, pp.&nbsp;9–14 (translated from the Russian original).

==Further reading==
*V. I. Arnol’d, O. Ya. Viro, E. A. Leontovich-Andronova, V. V. Nikulin, [[Sergei Novikov (mathematician)|S. P. Novikov]], O. A. Oleinik, G. M. Polotovsky, V. M. Kharlamov, "Dmitrii Andreevich Gudkov (on his seventieth birthday)", ''[[Russian Mathematical Surveys]]'', 1989, Volume 44, Issue 1, 271–273.
